debate: Jacob

Good morning everyone. We lost Sam, who was a villager, so we know the wolves are among the remaining six. To get us talking and spot early tells, let’s do a quick round-robin: each player shares one gut suspicion and why, in alphabetical order of our names (excluding me): Bert, Dan, David, Isaac, Paul, Tyler. I’ll listen first to you, Bert—who do you suspect and why?
Tyler

For my gut read, I’m suspicious of Dan. He’s been pretty quiet and noncommittal so far—wolves often try to blend in by keeping low profiles. Dan, how do you feel about being pegged as a suspect already?
Bert

My gut is on Isaac. He’s barely weighed in so far, and when he did, it felt half-hearted. Wolves often try to fly under the radar early. Isaac, what are your thoughts on someone else being under suspicion?
David

For my gut suspicion, I’m watching Tyler. He jumped on Dan almost immediately with just “wolves keep quiet” as his reasoning. Tyler, what specific behavior in Dan convinced you so fast? And Isaac, you’ve been quiet so far—what’s your take on this?
Dan

Thanks for the question, David. Tyler, basing your vote purely on my quietness feels like a shortcut to chaos rather than a real read. Early in the day most of us are listening, not plotting—your eagerness to point at me seems more suspicious than my silence. I’m putting my gut on Tyler here. Tyler, what else led you to zero in on me so quickly?
Paul

Thanks, Jacob. For my gut suspicion, I’m actually watching David. He’s been very quick to question Tyler and Isaac but hasn’t clearly stated his own read—wolves often steer the talk with probing questions rather than real suspicions. David, can you give us a concrete reason why Tyler is more suspicious than someone like Isaac?
Isaac

I actually agree with Paul’s point. David, you’ve been very quick to grill Tyler and Isaac, but you still haven’t given us a solid reason why Tyler is your top suspect instead of someone like Jacob or Bert. That kind of probing without your own clear read feels off to me. My gut is on you, David. Can you share a concrete behavior that convinced you Tyler’s the wolf? Otherwise, I’m seriously considering voting you.
